Calibrating a staff gauge after a flood

The spring flood moved the upstream staff gauge by four centimetres, so every reading since then carries the same offset until the datum is surveyed again.

We resurveyed the datum against the benchmark on the bridge pier and logged the correction in the station book, then compared a week of readings with the stilling well.

The stilling well and the corrected staff gauge now agree to within two millimetres, which is inside the tolerance the network asks of a manual station.
